name: MimicDiagnosisIcdToSid
title: MIMIC local ICD diagnosis codes to ICD-9-CM / ICD-10-CM
description: Maps MIMIC's local dot-less Condition.code codes onto the official dotted ICD codes, with the display and the release the code belongs to. Each group pins the target release in targetVersion; a code is mapped into the EARLIEST release that contains it. Lets consumers translate MIMIC codes on the fly rather than reading a rewritten copy of the source data.
purpose: This is a notation map, not a version crosswalk: every mapping is 'equivalent' and changes only how the code is written, never which concept it means. It is NOT an ICD-9-to-ICD-10 GEM.
